academics.title: Academic Mapping & Coordinator Approvals
academics.summary: Academic fit is the first blocker. Universidade Portucalense (UPT) offers a direct, hassle-free 100% course mapping in English. Universitat de Lleida (UdL) offers great courses but requires coordinator-approved substitutions for two subjects.

key_principles.name: UPT Porto Alignment
key_principles.description: All 4 courses are taught in the 1st semester (Winter) under Informatics Engineering and General Accounting. High English support. No substitutions required.

key_principles.name: UdL Lleida Alignment
key_principles.description: Web Design and Statistics are Spring-only in UdL's main Computer Science degree. Winter alternatives are available: Web dinàmica (Digital Design dept) and Estadística Avançada (FDET Business dept). Requires approvals.

key_principles.name: ECTS Equivalency
key_principles.description: ECTS credits are fully transferable 1:1 to CZU Prague. UdL's Operating Systems is a heavy 9 ECTS course, whereas UPT's is 6 ECTS.

academics.limits_on_antigravity: Learning Agreements must be signed by the CZU PEF coordinator (Veronika Brecklová) and the host coordinator (UPT: erasmus+_dct@upt.pt, UdL: Prof. Álvaro de Gracia eps.international@udl.cat) before departure.

finances.title: Erasmus+ Grants & Work Rights
finances.summary: Financial support is identical from CZU, but the cost of living differences between Porto and Lleida create a major divergence in your net monthly balance.

candidate_theories.name: Erasmus+ Grant Rate
candidate_theories.description: Both Spain and Portugal are Group B countries. CZU pays a base study grant of €600 per month.

candidate_theories.name: Green Travel Top-Up
candidate_theories.description: €50 one-time top-up for environmentally friendly travel (e.g. taking the train Prague -> Munich -> Paris -> Barcelona/Lleida) plus up to 4 days of daily grant.

candidate_theories.name: Fewer Opportunities
candidate_theories.description: An additional €250 per month top-up is available for students qualifying under the Fewer Opportunities criteria (e.g., specific social, health, or economic barriers).

challenges: Lleida (Studio vs. Shared): A studio costs €756-1010/mo (net -€156 to -€410 after grant), while a shared flat costs €518-840/mo (net +€82 to -€240). Sharing in Lleida is highly sustainable.
Porto (Studio vs. Shared): A studio costs €1000-1460/mo (net -€400 to -€860), while a shared flat costs €630-1090/mo (net -€30 to -€490). Porto requires substantial personal savings.
Spanish Work Rights: Non-EU students in Spain can work up to 30 hours per week under Royal Decree 1155/2024. Job search is automatic.
Portuguese Work Rights: Non-EU students in Portugal can work up to 20 hours per week during the semester, and full-time during holidays.

Remote Work & Social Security: To work remotely for a Czech employer, you remain a Czech tax resident (<183 days), but your employer must apply for a temporary A1 certificate to avoid foreign social security liabilities.

visa.title: Directive 2016/801 Student Mobility
visa.summary: As a Turkish citizen holding a valid Czech student residence permit, you are protected under EU Directive 2016/801 for intra-EU mobility. You do not need a new student visa, but notification is mandatory.
visa.mechanism: The host university's International Relations Office (ORI) must submit a formal mobility notification to the immigration authorities at least 1 month prior to arrival. If this is missed or late, your entry could be deemed illegal.

exotic_matter.explanation: For Spain, the UdL ORI notifies the Delegación del Gobierno en Cataluña. For Portugal, UPT notifies AIMA (Agency for Integration, Migration and Asylum).
exotic_matter.status: You must supply: passport scan, valid Czech residence permit, signed Learning Agreement, health insurance, and proof of financial means.

limitations: Spain: Processing takes up to 30 days. No news after 30 days represents administrative approval (silence is positive).
Portugal: Upon arrival, you must register your presence with AIMA/police within 30 days.
Czech Republic: Your Czech residence permit must remain valid for the entire duration of your Erasmus exchange. Do not let it expire!
Cyprus (Ruled Out): Non-Schengen. Turkish passport holders are explicitly excluded from visa-free entry with a Schengen permit. A national visa is mandatory but highly restricted.

housing.title: Student Housing & Pet-Friendly Leases
housing.summary: Securing accommodation is a major challenge, especially when traveling with a cat. Tenancy laws in both Spain and Portugal permit landlords to ban pets.

items.name: Porto Housing Market
items.claim: UPT does not own or operate official student dorms. Students must rent in the private market using platforms like Uniplaces, Spotahome, or Idealista.
items.scientific_fact: Average rents for T0 studios are €600-900/mo, and shared rooms are €300-600/mo. Best neighborhoods: Bonfim, Paranhos, Cedofeita, Baixa.
items.proof_of_debunk: Pet negotiation is difficult. Portuguese law allows landlords to insert a strict 'no-pets' clause in private contracts. If the contract is silent, you can keep a pet.

items.name: Lleida Housing Market
items.claim: UdL recommends residencias like La Vila de Lleida (prices start at €316/mo) and private shared flats.
items.scientific_fact: Shared flat rooms are €200-350/mo, and private T0 studios are €360-450/mo. Best neighborhoods: Cappont (near EPS campus and Boulder Indoor gym).
items.proof_of_debunk: Under Spanish Urban Leases Law (LAU), landlords can legally ban pets. You must seek written confirmation or ensure the lease has no pet prohibition clause.

pet_travel.title: Pet Travel Logistics (Prague to Destination)
pet_travel.summary: Relocating your cat requires meeting EU veterinary requirements and choosing the right transport logistics to manage weight limits.

items.name: Veterinary Compliance Timeline
items.claim: Cat must be microchipped, vaccinated for rabies, and issued an EU Pet Passport.
items.scientific_fact: Microchip must be ISO 11784/11785. The rabies vaccine must be given AFTER the microchip. You must wait at least 21 days after the rabies vaccine before traveling.
items.proof_of_debunk: An EU Pet Passport can be issued by any authorized Prague vet clinic. No rabies antibody titer test is needed for travel within Spain/Portugal.

items.name: Airline Choice & Cabin Limits
items.claim: Vueling (Prague -> Barcelona direct) offers a generous 10 kg limit (cat + soft carrier). TAP Portugal (Prague -> Porto direct) has a strict 8 kg limit.
items.scientific_fact: Vueling soft carrier size: 45 x 39 x 21 cm. TAP soft carrier size: 45 x 30 x 23 cm. TAP strictly weighs the pet and carrier at check-in.
items.proof_of_debunk: For Lleida: Fly Vueling to Barcelona (BCN), then take the high-speed Renfe/AVE train to Lleida-Pirineus (1h 15m, carrier allowed). For Porto: Fly TAP or Lufthansa direct.

climbing.title: Bouldering & Outdoor Climbing Scene
climbing.summary: Porto is an indoor-focused bouldering city, whereas Lleida is a world-class outdoor climbing capital. Your lifestyle quality will differ significantly.

items.name: Porto Gyms & Crags
items.claim: Porto has active indoor gyms but very limited outdoor climbing nearby.
items.scientific_fact: São Rock Climbing (near Campanhã station, €5 entry with ESN card) and Proa Climbing Center (€50/mo for students) offer great routes. The North Wall is accessible via Urban Sports Club.
items.proof_of_debunk: Outdoor crags are scarce. You will need to drive 1.5+ hours north to Braga or east to Serra da Estrela for real rock.

items.name: Lleida Gyms & Crags
items.claim: Lleida is a world-famous sport climbing hub with excellent, cheap indoor training.
items.scientific_fact: Boulder Indoor Lleida (Carrer de Tèrmens, 3) is a massive 1,700 m² gym costing just €44.50/mo for students. Fanatic is another local bouldering wall.
items.proof_of_debunk: Outdoor crags: Santa Linya, Oliana, Camarasa, and El Cogul (bouldering) are within 30-45 mins drive. Margalef and Siurana are within 60 mins. Carpooling (Blablacar) or active local groups are key.

literature.citation: EU Directive 2016/801 on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals for the purposes of research, studies, training, voluntary service, pupil exchange schemes or educational projects.
Spanish Royal Decree 1155/2024 amending the Regulation of Organic Law 4/2000 on the rights and freedoms of foreigners in Spain and their social integration (30-hour student work rule).
Portuguese Decree-Law no. 14/2021 amending the Legal Regime of Entry, Stay, Exit and Expulsion of Foreigners from National Territory (20-hour work limit for students).
Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 on the non-commercial movement of pet animals and repealing Regulation (EC) No 998/2003 (Microchip and Rabies requirements).
